text: In nineteen fifty-six, a test pilot shot down his own jet. With his own guns.
He was testing the cannons on a Grumman Tiger, firing bursts while diving at nearly the speed of sound.
The shells left faster than the jet, but drag slowed them and gravity pulled them down, right into the diving jet's path.
About eleven seconds later, he flew straight into his own shells. One cracked the windscreen. Another went into the engine.
He crash-landed short of the runway, badly hurt, and survived.
Dave flew the same test the next day.
